name: bno-cli
description: Terminal chat application for Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS

scripts.package: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-win-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-macos-arm64,node18-linux-x64 --output bin/bno
scripts.package:win: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output bin/bno.exe
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-macos-x64 --output bin/bno-macos-x64
scripts.package:mac-arm: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-macos-arm64 --output bin/bno-macos-arm64
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output bin/bno-linux

author: bnochat
